{{Quote|Sir, I wish you could see dawn touching this moon with your own eyes&mdash;after our persecutions, after our exile, after our long sufferings, the Colony has at last a homeland to rival&mdash;and I believe, even to surpass&mdash;old Setor.|Lile Gorsek, report to Commander Deffan|<ref name="GG22">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
'''Setor''' was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. A group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] were persecuted on, and then [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from, Setor nearly a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The colonists intended to settle the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]] but changes in financial support from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] left them virtually abandoned. The colonists then searched for a new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Lile Gorsek]] eventually became convinced that the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] would over [[Time/Legends|time]] allow the Wetyin's Colony's inhabitants to rival and even surpass their original home, Setor.

==Description==
Setor was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GG22" /> located in the [[Setor system/Legends|Setor system]], a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:WetyinsColony-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Colonists from Setor intended to settle Wetyin's Colony.]]
Nearly a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]<ref name="TEA" /> were [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from Setor<ref name="GG22" /> after suffering persecution.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|140|Setor}}</ref> The colonists were sent to the world [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], with [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] filled with [[Grain/Legends|grain]] [[Seed/Legends|seed]] and [[embryo]]s of the [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] creatures. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also granted the Setor exiles title to all agriculturally-promising uninhabited worlds of the Gordian Reach; however, the change in the budgets of the Imperial [[Minister/Legends|ministries]] then left the colonists virtually abandoned on Wetyin's Colony.<ref name="TEA" />

Eventually, [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from Wetyin's Colony searched for a new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for their people.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|15|YAV 1-4|Yavin 4}}</ref> When the scout [[Lile Gorsek]] sent a report on an initial flyover of the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Deffan]] of Wetyin's Colony, the former expressed confidence that that celestial body would eventually allow the colonists to rival and even eclipse Setor itself.<ref name="GG22" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Trebela-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|200px|The non-canon Trebela sector]]
Setor was first mentioned in the [[1989]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', which was published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Setor in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA" />

The magazine article "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]", which was published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]] without [[Lucas Licensing]] approval and is thus non-canon, placed Setor in the [[Trebela sector]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref>
